info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Data Switch Configuration API
info.description: The Market Data Switch Configuration API enables users to manage and update configurations related to market data switches within the banking environment. By utilizing this API, financial institutions can efficiently adapt their data flow settings in response to changing market conditions. Typical consumers include system administrators and application developers who require dynamic data management solutions. This API supports operations that ensure optimal performance and reliability of market data streams, promoting effective decision-making and data utilization.

patch.description: This endpoint allows for the modification of the market data switch administration settings for the specified resource. Use this operation to ensure that the settings are up to date and configured correctly.

requestBody.description: This PATCH request updates the configuration of the market data switch identified by RES-100045. The request body must contain the necessary fields to modify the current settings, structured as per the defined schema. Ensure that any required fields are included and that the data types match the specifications to ensure successful processing.
